snippet.title: 🎓 Professor Simulator – First Gameplay Showcase!
snippet.description:
This is our very first gameplay video of Professor Simulator, a relaxing idle management game where you lead your own research lab — recruit students, conduct experiments, publish papers, and survive the academic world.

The demo has just gone live on Steam, and we’ve been overwhelmed by your incredible support.
Even though it’s just a small demo, so many players have been helping us find bugs, sharing feedback, and even writing reviews and recommending it to friends — it truly means the world to us. ❤️

We’re a tiny indie team working day and night, doing our best to make this game something special.
Your feedback and encouragement keep us going — thank you, truly.

👉 Try the demo on Steam and join our community to follow the development journey!

#ProfessorSimulator #IndieGame #SimulationGame #SteamDemo #IndieDev
